title: Senior Specialist - Policy & Government Relations
description:
**Job Description:**  

Within the Policy Communications Department, we are seeking a proactive, dynamic, and results\-oriented professional to support the Associate Director, Policy Government Relations in advancing the companys policy priorities and institutional engagement agenda, as defined by the Italian Leadership Team.
  
  

The successful candidate will contribute to the development, management, and strengthening of relationships with key public and institutional stakeholders at both national and European levels. Working closely with the Associate Director, Policy Government Relations, the individual will help communicate the companys strategic vision, public policy priorities, and institutional projects to relevant stakeholders, supporting advocacy initiatives that promote a favorable environment for innovation and healthcare advancement.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor the political, policy, and institutional landscape at national and European levels, identifying potential opportunities and risks for the organization.
* Support institutional relations activities with key stakeholders involved in legislative, regulatory, and policy\-making processes.
* Contribute to the planning, organization, and coordination of meetings with government officials, policymakers, regulators, and institutional stakeholders.
* Assist in the development and execution of public affairs and advocacy strategies aligned with corporate priorities.
* Support the organization of institutional communication initiatives, including workshops, conferences, roundtables, and stakeholder events.
* Draft strategic policy documents, position papers, briefing materials, and institutional communications.
* Analyze legislative and regulatory developments relevant to the healthcare, pharmaceutical, and life sciences sectors.
* Contribute to legislative drafting activities and the preparation of policy proposals and consultation responses.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of policy and advocacy initiatives.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with relevant external organizations, trade associations, and institutional partners.


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Political Science, Law, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Public Affairs, Government Relations, Advocacy, and Stakeholder Engagement.
* Strong understanding of the Italian and European political, institutional, and regulatory environments.
* Solid knowledge of legislative and regulatory processes.
* Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with institutional stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Established network of stakeholders across government, healthcare, industry associations, and policy communities.
* Experience drafting position papers, policy analyses, briefing documents, and advocacy materials.
* Strong presentation development and institutional communication skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Italian and English.


Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration capabilities.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Proactive approach, initiative, and problem\-solving attitude.
* Strategic thinking and analytical skills.
* Strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good understanding of digital communication channels and social media platforms.


What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Effective support in advancing the company’s policy and advocacy priorities.
* Strong and trusted relationships with key institutional stakeholders.
* High\-quality policy analysis and strategic recommendations.
* Successful execution of institutional engagement initiatives and events.
* Contribution to a positive external policy environment supporting innovation, healthcare sustainability, and patient access.

We are seeking an experienced Delivery Lead – SAP BI / Analytics \& Avature to own and govern key digital People \& Culture (P\&C) solutions
across the UniCredit Group. In this role, you will ensure that P\&C business objectives are translated into reliable, timely, compliant, and highquality
digital outcomes, balancing strategic direction with operational excellence.
This is a managerial and technical role with full end\-to\-end accountability for delivery. You will lead both run and change activities for the SAP
Business Warehouse platform used across multiple countries, including group\-wide HR Managerial Reporting and country\-specific reporting
processes, as well as the Avature cloud SaaS used for talent acquisition, onboarding, and several user\-group specific portals.
You will act as the key functional and technical authority and trusted partner to P\&C stakeholders, owning both run and change topics and ensuring
the long\-term stability, compliance, and evolution of the P\&C application landscape.  


### **What you'll be doing**

* Act as the primary product owner and reference for UniCredit’s SAP Business Warehouse solution as well as the Avature cloud SaaS ensuring smooth P\&C business operations.
* Serve as central interface between P\&C business stakeholders and IT, advising on requirements, further developments, and consulting on solution design and optimization.
* Manage, coordinate and steer all change projects in the reporting/analytics area as well as for P\&C processes around external/internal recruiting, on/offboarding or skill assessment.
* Coordinate the team of internal and external product specialists to ensure application maintenance and change projects for both areas, including the
* SaaS provider Avature.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to:
* Clarify objectives and success criteria
* Define and prioritize requirements
* Ensure requirements are clearly documented, feasible from a technical and operational perspective, and aligned with enterprise architecture and standards
* Control scope changes and manage trade\-offs between time, cost, and functionality.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring long\-term system stability, compliance, and scalability of the relevant applications.
  


### **What you'll need to succeed**

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in complex IT and/or digital delivery environments.
* Profound knowledge of SAP Business Warehouse solution (Rel. 7\.5\), including data modeling and front\-end technologies (Web reporting,
* SAP Business Objects).
* Solid understanding of SAP customizing concepts, ABAP developments, and transport mechanisms.
* Experience with the management of SaaS solutions, preferably with Avature talent acquisition suite. Willingness and ability to quickly build
* in\-depth Avature expertise through self\-driven learning and the Avature training platform.
* Good understanding of legal and regulatory framework for P\&C processes, including familiarity with EU directives impacting Recruiting and
* Onboarding, including GDPR.
* Experience with HR processes in banking or financial services environment is highly desirable.
* Foster a delivery culture focused on accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.
* English C1 or higher – essential for stakeholder workshops, collaboration with providers, and documentation.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and consulting capabilities, including interaction with business counterparts.
  


### **What you'll get in return**

**\#MakeInnovationHappen**: Chance to make an impact in terms of transformation**\#UnlockYourPotential**: Join a young and stimulating environment**\#ComeAsYouAre**: Working within a global team**\#UnlockYourPotential**: Play a role of autonomy with high visibility and exposure**\#BalanceLifeAndCareer**: Flexible working hours \& working hybrid
### **About UniCredit Group**

Die UniCredit ist eine führende, paneuropäische Geschäftsbank, die erstklassige Lösungen und Services in Italien, Deutschland, Österreich, Zentral\- und Osteuropa bietet. Unsere Vision ist es, die Bank für Europas Zukunft zu sein. Unser Anspruch lautet: Empower Communities to Progress. Er beinhaltet, allen Stakeholdern erstklassige Produkte und Services zu bieten und dadurch das Potenzial unserer Kund:innen und Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa zur Entfaltung zu bringen. Wir betreuen mehr als 20 Millionen Kund:innen, unterstützt von drei gruppenweiten Produktbereichen \- Corporate, Individual und Payment Solutions \-, mit denen wir in all unsere Märkten eine erstklassige Expertise und skalierbare Lösungen bereitstellen können. Unser integriertes Geschäftsmodell verbindet lokale Nähe und ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Kund:innen mit den Stärken einer internationalen Gruppe und schafft dadurch nahtlos ineinandergreifende Services und ein exzellentes Kundenerlebnis. Digitalisierung, operative Exzellenz und ein starkes Bekenntnis zu den ESG\-Grundsätzen bilden das Fundament unseres Handelns und ermöglichen es uns, nachhaltig Mehrwert für Kund:innen, Gemeinschaften, Mitarbeitende und Aktionär:innen zu schaffen. Unsere gemeinsame Kultur verbindet unsere Mitarbeitenden über alle Länder hinweg und stärkt Zusammenarbeit, konsequente Umsetzung und Ambition \- getragen von unseren Werten Integrity, Ownership und Caring.

description:
**Company Description**  

Artisan of travel since 1883, Orient Express sublimates the art of travel with its luxury trains, hotels, and sailing yachts. The brand has just launched its first hotel, Orient Express La Minerva, in Rome – and followed by Orient Express Venezia in 2026\. The experience continues with the recent launch of La Dolce Vita Orient Express train, followed by Orient Express Corinthian in 2026, the first of two Orient Express Sailing Yachts, and finally, the return of L’Orient Express train to railways. Since 2022, Orient Express is part of Accor Group’s leading collection of luxury brands with a century\-old legacy in the hotels and fine\- dining sectors. In 2024, Accor and LVMH entered into a strategic partnership to accelerate the development of Orient Express. Follow the journey at @orientexpress on Instagram or visit the website at www.orient\-express.com.

**About Orient Express La Minerva**


Considered as the beloved capital of the Orient Express legend, Rome is the first Orient Express hotel, La Minerva, in 2025\. Orient Express has entrusted the interior architecture and artistic direction of the hotel Hugo Toro. The former Palazzo Fonseca is a sumptuous 17th\-century palace with a huge, majestic façade. A place of memory still adorned with its Roman columns, sculptures by Rinaldo Rinaldi, a disciple of Canova, and the fascinating goddess Minerva. At the end of 2024, a new décor and interior inspired by the Roman domus and the riches of the "Eternal City" will be revealed with a new touch of contemporary elegance.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a People \& Culture Manager to lead the People \& Culture function and shape a best\-in\-class employee experience for our onboard crew and operational teams.


Reporting to the General Manager, the People \& Culture Manager will drive strategic HR initiatives to foster a high\-performance, inclusive and compliant workplace. The role is central in managing end\-to\-end HR strategy,the employee lifecycle, crew workforce planning, and labour relations — all with an unwavering commitment to our luxury standards and guest service excellence.

**Strategic Leadership \& HR Operations**

* Define and deliver the HR strategy in alignment with the General Manager and the corporate guidelines of Orient Express.
* Lead the full spectrum of HR functions: talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, learning \& development, compensation \& benefits, payroll, and personnel administration.
* Translate business priorities into effective people strategies and operational HR solutions.
* Ensure a culture of continuous improvement and alignment with the brand’s identity and luxury positioning.
* Update, review and ensure compliance with LQA/Forbes.

**Workforce Planning**


* Co\-lead with Finance the planning and monitoring of employment costs, ensuring alignment with operational budgets and staffing forecasts.
* Manage the People \& Culture department budget, balancing service excellence with cost\-effectiveness.
* Monitor key crew\-related KPIs, including resources, absenteeism, shift coverage, and compliance with rest periods and working time regulations.
* Work closely with the Operations team to ensure service continuity, responsiveness to unexpected changes, and agility during peak periods.
* Contribute to the development of scalable workforce planning processes and tools to support future network expansion and evolving regulatory frameworks.

**Industrial \& Union Relations**

* Maintain structured, constructive relationships with trade unions and employee representatives representing the company in all collective and individual labour matters.
* Manage individual and collective disputes, disciplinary processes, and grievance cases with discretion and compliance.

**People Engagement \& Workplace Culture**

* Promote a culture of well\-being, engagement, and excellence across all departments.
* Oversee the onboarding journey to ensure every new team member feels welcomed, trained, and aligned with brand values.
* Support managers in developing positive team dynamics, implementing action plans to improve collaboration and service culture.
* Deploy initiatives that bring to life the Orient Express values and elevate the candidate and employee experience.

  

  

**Qualifications*** Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior HR role.
* Experience within luxury hospitality is mandatory.
* Deep knowledge and hands\-on experience in industrial and union relations, including collective bargaining and employment law.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; fluent in Italian and English (written and spoken).
* Entrepreneurial spirit with strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Hands\-on and strategic, able to operate effectively across both day\-to\-day execution and long\-term planning.
* Proficiency with HR systems and tools (HRIS, ATS, scheduling software, payroll platforms, etc.).

 **Additional Information*** Gross annual salary range:50\.000 \- 60\.000 € \+ bonus
* Staff cantine
* ALL \- Heartist® Program: Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at all ACCOR locations and partner venues worldwide.
* Learning \& development: Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
* Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

**Cosa farai**
--------------


* In qualità di Account Manager non ti limiterai a vendere, ma dovrai sviluppare nuove possibilità di business, gestendo processi e collaboratori.
* Ogni giorno sarà una nuova sfida: ti troverai in cantieri, uffici, aziende o impianti produttivi, sempre al centro dell’azione!
* Lavorerai sul campo, mettendoti alla prova in un ambiente dinamico, sfidante e sempre in evoluzione.
* Collaborerai con numerosi stakeholder interni, come Field Engineer, PMO e Business Developer.
* Presenterai i prodotti più innovativi, illustrerai i nostri software più all’avanguardia e proporrai servizi e soluzioni uniche e personalizzate.
* Costruirai rapporti di fiducia con i clienti, aiutandoli a trovare le migliori soluzioni Hilti per il loro business.
* In Hilti avrai la stessa autonomia che potresti avere nel gestire una piccola azienda, ma non sarai mai solo!

**Cosa porti con te**
---------------------


Non valutiamo solo titoli o esperienze: vogliamo te, con le tue idee, la tua energia e il tuo modo unico di contribuire. Sei il fit perfetto se hai:  

  

  



* Laurea
* Eccellenti capacità comunicative e relazionali.
* Esperienza minima o forte interesse nelle vendite.
* Capacità di porti obiettivi chiari e la voglia di raggiungerli.
* Proattività, ambizione ed entusiasmo.
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
* Patente di guida da almeno 1 anno.

**Che vantaggi ci sono per te?**
--------------------------------


Entrare a far parte del nostro team significa poter contare su un percorso professionale meritocratico e orientato alla crescita.
  

  

Retribuzione e inquadramento  

  



* Contratto a tempo indeterminato, full\-time
* Inquadramento con CCNL Commercio III Livello
* RAL \+ retribuzione variabile al target non inferiore a €40\.000

  

La retribuzione effettiva sarà definita sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali esperienza professionale, competenze tecniche, responsabilità del ruolo e qualifiche possedute, nel rispetto dei principi di equità, trasparenza e pari opportunità retributive.
  

  

Welfare e benefit
  

Offriamo un pacchetto di benefit pensato per supportare il benessere delle persone e delle loro famiglie:
  

* Piano Welfare aziendale
* Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa Hilti, aggiuntiva rispetto ai fondi di categoria
* Coperture assicurative dedicate (vita, infortuni professionali ed extraprofessionali, long term care e tutela legale da circolazione civile)
* Accesso a piattaforme dedicate al wellbeing e al benessere personale
* Convenzioni aziendali e agevolazioni dedicate
* Auto aziendale a uso strumentale
* Telefono aziendale ad uso promiscuo

  

Crescita e sviluppo
  

Crediamo nella valorizzazione delle persone attraverso percorsi di formazione continua, sviluppo professionale e opportunità di crescita interna, in un contesto internazionale e inclusivo.  

  

**Perché Hilti**
----------------


Hilti è leader globale nell'innovazione nel settore delle costruzioni, con oltre 34\.000 membri del team in 120 Paesi. Ispirati dal nostro obiettivo di migliorare il settore delle costruzioni (Making Construction Better), vogliamo continuare a imparare, crescere e trovare nuovi modi per avere un impatto duraturo. In Hilti, ti daremo la possibilità di sfruttare i tuoi punti di forza, lavorare con un team globale e inclusivo e affrontare sfide significative. Con noi avrai l'opportunità di realizzare le tue idee, i tuoi obiettivi e la tua crescita grazie a determinazione, passione e lavoro di squadra.  

  



**Impegno a favore dell'inclusione**
------------------------------------


In Hilti, l'inclusione è un aspetto fondamentale del modo in cui lavoriamo, guidiamo e cresciamo insieme. Siamo determinati ad abbracciare la diversità di pensiero e a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti, ovunque. Ci impegniamo costantemente per assicurarci che ogni voce sia apprezzata e che ogni membro del team senta di avere la possibilità di dare il proprio contributo. Costruendo su questa base, rafforziamo i nostri team, la nostra innovazione e il nostro impatto, migliorando il settore delle costruzioni insieme.  

  



DOPO LA CANDIDATURA
  

  

In Hilti crediamo fermamente che ogni percorso inizi da un dialogo autentico e positivo. Per questo, mettiamo la trasparenza al centro di ogni fase del processo di selezione, condividendo aspettative, tempi e feedback con chiarezza e rispetto.
  

  

Nell’ottica di un processo trasparente, l’iter di selezione prevede i seguenti step:
  

1\. Phonescreen conoscitiva della durata di circa 20 minuti.
  

2\. Primo colloquio via Teams con un recruiter del team Talent Acquisition.
  

3\. Secondo colloquio via Teams con l’Hiring Manager di riferimento per la posizione aperta.
  

4\. Field\-ride: mezza giornata in affiancamento sul campo per toccare con mano il day\-to\-day tipo di un Account Manager. Questo step non è valutativo e viene proposto da Hilti al solo scopo di dare al candidato una visione concreta di ciò che lo aspetta.
  

  

Se c’è qualcosa che possiamo fare per rendere il processo di candidatura e selezione più confortevole, ti invitiamo a farcelo sapere. Siamo un’azienda che offre pari opportunità e riteniamo che ognuno debba avere le stesse chance di avere successo nel nostro team.

Flutter, the world’s largest online sports betting and iGaming group listed on the London and New York stock exchanges, is home to the Southern Europe \& Africa (SEA) region, featuring iconic brands like Sisal, Snai and PokerStars, a globally loved brand that embodies innovation and ambition, with significant growth potential in a dynamic market.

* 12\-month fixed\-term contract with hybrid working model

* Opportunities for learning, growth and cross\-country collaboration.
* Meal allowance.
* Supplemental Health Insurance.

Flutter SEA is an Equal Opportunity Organization. Diversity and Inclusion are fundamental values for us. We welcome any candidate without distinction of sex, age, culture, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression.

Given that the funding of this position is strictly limited in duration and conditional upon the availability of supplementary funds, should the funding cease, the position will be abolished and the staff member concerned will be subject to the relevant provisions set out in the HR Implementing Procedures.**


The International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) is an international financial institution, and a specialized United Nations agency dedicated to eradicating rural poverty and hunger. It does so by investing in rural people. IFAD finances programmes and projects that increase agricultural productivity and raise rural incomes, and advocates at the local, national and international level for policies that contribute to rural transformation.


The Department for Country Operations (DCO) oversees the origination, design and management of IFAD investments, including sovereign and non\-sovereign operations, as well as the design and implementation of non\-lending activities within country programmes, including policy engagement and SSTC. DCO is the department that primarily interfaces with governments, the private sector and other stakeholders to deliver IFAD's programme of work and to provide oversight to ensure quality of the portfolio.


DCO is led by an Associate Vice\-President and is composed of five (5\) regional divisions: Asia and the Pacific Division (APR), East and Southern Africa Division (ESA), Latin America and Caribbean Division (LAC) , Near East, North Africa and Europe Division (NEN) and West and Central Africa Division (WCA), the Private Sector Operations Division (PSD), and two (2\) units: the South\-South and Triangular Cooperation Unit (SSTC) and the fragility unit (FRU).


The Private Sector operations Division (PSD) is led by a Divisional Director based in IFAD Headquarters in Rome, Italy. PSD is responsible for origination, structuring, delivery and portfolio management of IFAD private sector investments, or Non\-Sovereign Operations (NSO), as well as for business development, which includes developing the NSO pipeline and supporting complementarity between NSOs and sovereign operations within country programmes. PSD is composed of a front office and two Units: the Investment Unit and the Trust Fund Management and Control Unit, which is responsible for the management and control of the Private Sector Trust Fund and other off\-balance as well as the on\-balance sheet funding (PSD financial resources). The Division works in close coordination with other divisions in DCO and other departments, offices, and divisions in IFAD. In alignment with the decentralised structure of the Fund, the division operates in a geographically distributed manner, including IFAD Headquarters and Regional Offices.


**Position Specifics:**
  

IFAD has structured and launched the Agri\-Business Capital Fund (ABC Fund) as one of three pillars to drive inclusive smallholder and rural SME finance, as well as create employment opportunities for rural youth and women. Impact Fund investments are core to IFAD's NSO Investment Strategy for IFAD to pursue its objective to mobilize additional concessional funding for agricultural development in developing Member States. The ABC Fund is a blended capital vehicle anchored by the European Commission (EC), the African, Caribbean and Pacific Groups of States, the government of Luxembourg and the Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa (AGRA). It is supported by a technical assistance facility also managed by IFAD. By providing loans and equity investments, the ABC Fund aims at bridging the funding gap at the level of SMEs agribusiness companies, financial institutions and farmer organizations in Africa and other developing countries, while the technical assistance facility is expected to address their non\-financial constraints.


The incumbent plays a key role in the fulfilment of ABC Fund activities as indicated in the relevant agreement between EC and IFAD. He/she works under the direct supervision of a Lead Investment Officer, PSD, and under the indirect supervision of the Director, PSD.  

  



**Job Role**
------------

  

The incumbent is an expert in a specialized thematic area. The incumbent provides technical expertise and strategic guidance at the corporate level and all stages of design, development, monitoring and evaluation of IFAD's private sector investments. The incumbent may work collaboratively with other thematic Technical Specialists, Country Directors, Investment Officers and other staff to ensure consistency, cohesion and synergy in the application of technical advice and provision of programme development support.


**Position specifics:**


Under the supervision of the Lead Investment Officer, PSD, the incumbent has a regional technical role in private investment and private sector operational engagements, with particular focus on ABC related activities and associated interlinkages. The incumbent works collaboratively with the Regional team, including Country Directors and regionally mapped thematic Technical Specialists, as well as with the rest of PSD staff, to ensure consistency, cohesion and synergy in the application of technical advice and provision of private sector operation and activities.


The incumbent contributes to: a.) the delivery of IFAD's private sector investment activities (Non\-Sovereign private sector Operations\-NSOs) in the region of focus as well as exceptionally on a global level, as required; b.) advising on, and facilitating, the integration of a private sector development and private sector investment perspective into Country Strategic Opportunities Programmes (COSOPs) and sovereign projects in the region of focus, upon request from the Regional Director and concerned Country Directors and based on planning agreed with Director PSD; c.) activities carried out by PSD globally, including in the areas of partnerships, knowledge management, and reporting.


**Key Functions and Results**
-----------------------------

  

1\. SENIOR TECHNICAL ADVICE IN PRIVATE SECTOR INVESTMENT: The incumbent will work closely with country directors, technical specialists and regionally assigned staff on the origination, screening, structuring and delivery of IFAD Non\-Sovereign private sector operations (NSOs) which could entail both direct funding and indirect through financial intermediaries. Main accountabilities include:


* Work with Country Directors and other staff in country teams and in the regional team to develop a pipeline of potential NSO investments (including both regular and blended finance operations), notably NSOs promoting job creation, women economic empowerment and those supporting mitigation and adaptation efforts to climate change, or other themes as requested.
* Screen potential NSOs both in terms of development impact and financial soundness, structure and lead the drafting of investment proposals and support the Lead Investment Officer and Director PSD, throughout the internal review process to seek Board Approval; ensure post approval management, implementation and supervision.
* Engage with various key divisions at IFAD to ensure efficient and effective review, development and implementation of the NSOs;
* Provide senior level support to the Lead Investment Officer, Country Directors, and Regional Directors in building operational relationships with private sector partners within the scope of Country Strategies and of sovereign investments;
* Provide senior level support to the Lead Investment Officer, Country Directors and Regional Directors to integrate NSOs within IFAD country programmes;
* Support the identification and mapping of the private sector landscape and market context within value chains prioritized for focus in selected country programmes in the region of focus; and
* Lead field and due diligence missions at all stages of the project cycle, including during design, due diligence, implementation and monitoring and undertaking implementation support missions, including supervision of NSOs.

2\. SUPPORT THE DELIVERY AND REPORTING OF PSD WORK PROGRAM


* Assist the Lead Investment Officer and the Director, PSD in the delivery of the PSD work plan; to build synergies and capacity to ensure close coordination and collaboration among the various teams;
* Assist the Lead Investment Officer and Director, PSD to respond in an adaptive manner to the evolving priorities and opportunities around and within IFAD and the various initiatives and external partnerships; and
* Provide support to the Lead Investment Officer and Director, PSD in the delivery of PSD Special Initiatives

3\. KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT: The incumbent will support and ensure appropriate country\-level access to the latest sources of knowledge and innovation on private sector investments, private sector development and establish new knowledge and partnerships in support to the operational needs of country teams in the region of focus, as well as in support to the regional NSO agenda.
  

Accountabilities include:


* Provide support on the drafting and review on the development of relevant policies and procedures, guidelines, monitoring tools, manuals, etc.
* Provide senior\-level support to the development and delivery of training modules focused on developing high\-performing and high\-impact Private Sector (PS) programs;
* Participate in IFAD\-wide thematic discussions and develop appropriate technical and operations on private sector.
* Perform other activities necessary to implement IFAD's Private Sector Operational Engagement Strategy.
* Develop lessons learnt on NSOs.
* Oversee special initiatives and programs hosted by PSD

4\. PARTNERSHIP BUILDING AND RESOURCE MOBILIZATION: The incumbent helps to mobilize resources and build relevant partnerships. Accountabilities include:


* Develop partnerships and outreach activities as well as new relationships with DFIs, impact investors, foundations and corporate partners to expand resources, market and income opportunities for smallholders, small\-scale producers, cooperatives and/or agribusiness;
* Ensure IFAD's representation and communication in technical issues (including representing IFAD at international, regional, inter\-agency meetings, seminars and conferences fora);
* Contribute to the mobilisation of resources for NSOs in collaboration with the External Relationship Department, through partnerships and outreach activities; and
* Support the development of thematic investment platforms.

5\. MONITORING, EVALUATION AND REPORTING: The incumbent contributes to managing the monitoring, evaluation and reporting of NSOs. Accountabilities include:


* Support the development and/or application of a results framework for NSOs;
* Implement performance monitoring systems and new approaches to performance and NSOs portfolio monitoring; and
* Prepare analytical findings and reports for divisional and country\-level decision making on project viability and sustainability.

6\. MANAGERIAL FUNCTIONS: The incumbent is accountable for integrity, transparency, and equity in the management of IFAD resources, including equipment, supplies and, as applicable, staff supervised. The incumbent may also be asked to supervise work of external consultants and more junior staff.


**Position specifics:**


The above functions will be performed with a main focus on ABC Fund and on the region(s) assigned. Exceptionally, the incumbent may be required to perform them for other regions, as required.


**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

  

Assignments require the provision of seasoned technical expertise and input for the full programme/project cycle as well as in knowledge sharing with peers and counterparts. The work goes beyond technical analysis and synthesis to include substantive inputs to project methodology and design of projects, knowledge sharing among peers and counterparts to enhance cooperation, complementarity and synergy and monitoring and evaluation to measure and report on lessons learned and best practices. The work is considered moderately complex requiring in\-depth technical analysis and reporting. Typically operating as a specialist at the country or regional levels, the incumbent's work may be reviewed for technical accuracy, but more typically is reviewed for achieving the established work plan.


**Position specifics**:


The work assignments require the provision of seasoned technical expertise, technical analysis and input for ABC, and other interlinked programs, projects and initiatives related to private sector investments and private sector development, as well as knowledge sharing among peers and counterparts to enhance cooperation, complementarity and synergy and monitoring and evaluation to measure and report on lessons learned and best practices.


**Working Relationships**
-------------------------

  

The work relationships of the incumbent at this level are primarily for the exchange of information regarding development projects. Information\-gathering and exchange in support of studies and thematic assignments may also include identifying reliable sources and establishing guidelines for obtaining information on national and sub\-regional context/conditions and to convey methodological approaches and operational experience for implementation of activities undertaken on behalf of the Fund.


**Position specifics:**


The work relationships of the incumbent involves the provision of technical advice and the negotiation and resolution of problems that arise in private sector project design and appraisal, supervision/implementation support and in the preparation of studies and reports with a focus on the ABC Fund. The incumbent serves as an expert in private sector investments and works with full technical independence in the provision of technical expertise and methodological guidance at the country level, as well as regionally as required. Contacts are with counterparts and senior officials within other DFIs, United Nations organizations having related programmes and with officials of governments, private sector and foundations, non\-governmental and inter\-governmental organizations, impact investors.


In servicing inter\-governmental bodies, expert groups and other meetings, the including both regular and blended finance operations provides technical expertise and recommendations for policy formulation and official conclusions in a consultative capacity; the incumbent also may provide information regarding the organization's policies, and act as the representative of the organization. Contacts are maintained to identify and evaluate emerging developments.


**Job Profile Requirements**
----------------------------

  

**Organizational Competencies:**

  

  

**Level 2:**


* Building relationships and partnerships \- Builds and maintains strategic partnerships internally and externally
  

Communicating and negotiating \- Acquires \& uses a wide range of communication styles \& skills
* Demonstrating leadership \- Leads by example; initiates and supports change
* Focusing on clients \- Contributes to a client\-focused culture
* Learning, sharing knowledge and innovating \- Challenges, innovates \& contributes to learning culture
* Managing performance and developing staff \- Manages wider teams with greater impact on others and on the organization
* Managing time, resources and information \- Coordinates wider use of time, information and/or resources
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making \- Solves complex problems and makes decisions that have wider corporate impact
* Strategic thinking and organizational development \- Staff in management and/or strategic leadership roles
* Team working \- Fosters a cohesive team environment
  

  

**Education:**


* Level \- Advanced university degree from an accredited institution; an advanced university degree may be substituted by a first university degree (Bachelor or equivalent) plus at least four additional years of relevant professional experience, over and above the minimum number of years of experience.

Areas \- Finance, Rural Finance, Agricultural Economics, Business, or a relevant discipline.  
* 

**Experience:**


* At least eight (8\) years of progressively responsible experience in the area of structuring and management of rural finance and agriculture private sector investments in developing countries, including private equity experience, of which at least 2 of the 8 years of experience should be at the international level.

Active experience in serving as non\-executive board member or investment committee member in impact fund is a plus  
* 

**Languages:**


* Required: English (4 \- Excellent)

Desirable: French, Spanish, Portuguese and/or Arabic (3 \- Good)  
* 

**Skills:**


* Communication strategy: Expert in planning and implementing internal and external communication to achieve communication objectives: defining communication goals, target audience, creating a communication plan and identifying the right channels. Expert in communication concepts, processes, or data to support long term goals of the organisation;
* Adaptability: Adaptability and flexibility when facing new or unexpected situations, and to specific constraints and circumstances and managing complex processes
* Corporate approach: Ability to bring in corporate vision and priorities into one's area of work (e.g. budgeting going beyond simple budgetary considerations, taking into account strategic priorities)
* Interpersonal skills: Ability to deal patiently and tactfully with others (e.g. visitors, clients, callers, etc.), including senior individuals (e.g. high\-level meeting participants)
* Synthesis: Outstanding ability to synthesize and simplify complex technical information for a variety of (non\-technical) audiences
* Verbal communication: Clear, succinct and convincing verbal communication; highly professional, balanced and diplomatic language
* Written communication: Clear, succinct and convincing written communication in the language needed for specific role; highly professional, balanced and diplomatic language (e.g. for drafting of position papers, briefings, etc.)
* Evidence\-based policy: Know\-how in the formulation of concrete and actionable policy recommendations based on hard evidence (going beyond simple data interpretation)
* Private Sector Investment: Expertise in assessing private sector investment proposals, review of transactions and complex facilities and interventions using regular and blended finance, conducting due diligence, and recommending financial/investment decisions accordingly; Proven expertise in deploying financial instruments
* Authoritative expertise in the area of private sector investments applied to rural finance and agriculture in emerging markets, experience in private equity and in Africa, Caribbean and Pacific regions is an asset;
* Proven experience in reviewing, structuring and managing private sector investments as well as management of development projects supported by international organizations;
* Ability to share guidance/knowledge at the governmental and peer levels as well as to inspire more junior specialists and staff in the development of viable project activities.

Good analytical and drafting skills in English.  
*

**Descrizione del lavoro**
--------------------------

**POSIZIONE \-** Financial Planning \& Analysis Expert
  

**AREA ORGANIZZATIVA \-** Finance \& Legal / Programme Management  

**SEDE DI RIFERIMENTO** \- Roma / Ibrido
  

**SUPERVISORE** \- Head of Financial Planning and Analysis
  

**TIPOLOGIA CONTRATTUALE** \- Co.co.co.  

**RANGE RETRIBUTIVO** \- 29\.000 – 32\.000  

**LIVELLO SAFEGUARDING** \- 1

  


**INCARICO**

Il/La Financial Planning \& Analysis Expert contribuisce alla gestione finanziaria, sia attiva sia passiva, di uno o più Programmi, garantendo un presidio efficace delle attività di reporting, controllo finanziario e monitoraggio della compliance con le procedure interne ed esterne. Il ruolo assicura un supporto qualificato ai processi decisionali, favorendo una gestione trasparente, accurata e coerente delle risorse economiche e finanziarie assegnate.



**PRINCIPALI ATTIVITA’/RESPONSABILITA’**


**Gestione finanziaria:**


* coordinamento e finalizzazione della pianificazione finanziaria annuale delle aree tematiche di riferimento;
* revisione, verifica e supporto nello sviluppo dei budget delle singole componenti progettuali;
* supervisione della gestione finanziaria di staff e progettuale, secondo i requisiti di Save the Children Italia e di ogni singolo donatore;
* individuazione e organizzazione di formazioni amministrative e ad hoc e capacity building per referenti di progetto delle aree programmatiche di riferimento, ove necessario;
* analisi del rischio finanziario/gestionale e sviluppo di strategie di riduzione dello stesso, al fine di garantire il perseguimento degli obiettivi progettuali;
* partecipazione a meeting con donatori potenziali, finalizzata alla supervisione della parte gestionale e finanziaria, ove richiesto;
* Monitoraggio del budget e sviluppo di proposte progettuali nell’ambito delle aree programmatiche di riferimento
* monitoraggio con cadenza trimestrale della implementazione del budget delle aree programmatiche di riferimento e nelle singole componenti progettuali anche al fine di intervenire in caso di scostamenti;
* Supporto al Program manager e/o ai referenti gestionali delle aree programmatiche di riferimento, nella gestione economico\-finanziaria progettuale, nell’implementazione budgetaria e nella pianificazione e imputazione finanziaria delle risorse umane;
* supporto nello sviluppo di proposte progettuali per donatori privati e istituzionali;
* supervisione di proposte di modifica budgetaria da presentare e discutere con i donatori;
* verifica e supporto nella redazione di proposte di modifica budgetaria presentate dai partner di progetti nell'ambito delle Aree Programmatiche di riferimento;
* supporto nella identificazione e gestione di partner progettuali.



Tutte le attività elencate dovranno essere realizzate in stretto raccordo con le aree Programmatiche di riferimento (principalmente tramite le figure dei Program Manager e dei coordinatori di progetto), la Direzione Finance (Aree Legal, Grant e Contabilità) e sotto la supervisione della Head of Financial Planning and Analysis.


**Reportistica:**


* controllo e revisione dei rapporti finanziari dei partner di progetto, seguendo le regole di Save the Children e dei donatori;
* supervisione della preparazione di tutta la documentazione necessaria ai fini della reportistica finanziaria;
* finalizzazione della reportistica finanziaria dei progetti grant, in collaborazione e sotto la supervisione dell’area Grant di Save the Children Italia.


**Altre attività specifiche:**


* verificare l'accuratezza delle registrazioni dei costi progettuali attraverso controlli periodici sul sistema di gestione contabile utilizzato da Save the Children;
* supportare l'ufficio Payroll per una corretta imputazione dei costi del personale;
* Contribuire allo sviluppo e al miglioramento delle procedure di gestione finanziaria e progettuale interne a Save the Children Italia
* supportare il processo di finalizzazione di accordi di partenariato;
* fornire supporto in occasione di audit interne ed esterne, in coordinamento con gli altri uffici coinvolti;
* partecipare a riunioni periodiche di coordinamento del Dipartimento;
* partecipare a meeting convocati ad hoc dalle aree programmatiche di riferimento;
* partecipare a meeting convocati dagli eventuali donatori;
* coordinamento e finalizzazione del processo di preparazione del budget, della sua revisione semestrale (re\-forecast) e della pre\-chiusura annuale per le aree programmatiche di riferimento, secondo i termini e le modalità comunicate dalla Direzione Finance.


**ESPERIENZE, QUALIFICHE E CONOSCENZE LINGUISTICHE/INFORMATICHE**


* Esperienza di 4 anni in monitoraggio e rendicontazione finanziaria.
* Competenze amministrative, conoscenza dei principi contabili e di rendicontazione
* Laurea, preferibilmente in Economia
* Buona conoscenza dell’inglese, parlato e scritto
* Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office


**SOFT SKILLS**


* Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio
* Flessibilità
* Spiccate capacità relazionali e di mediazione
* Gestione dello stress

**ALTRO**


* Condivisione della mission e dei principi di Save the Children.


**SAFEGUARDING**



Save the Children vuole essere un’organizzazione sicura per tutte le persone beneficiarie \- minori e adulte \- che raggiunge con i propri programmi. Per questo motivo implementa un sistema di tutela per prevenire qualsiasi rischio di abuso e sfruttamento in loro danno.  

Coloro che collaborano a qualunque titolo con Save the Children dovranno dimostrare i più alti standard di comportamento così come indicato nella **Policy sulla Tutela di Bambine, Bambini e Adolescenti** e nella **Policy** **per la Protezione di beneficiari/e maggiorenni dallo sfruttamento sessuale, l’abuso, le molestie** (https://www.savethechildren.it/policies).

  


**LE PERSONE AL CENTRO**  

Lavorare per una missione come quella di Save the Children è importante.



Crediamo che un’Organizzazione fatta di persone che stanno bene e che hanno passione per il proprio lavoro, è un’Organizzazione innovativa, coesa, agile ed efficiente, che riesce quindi ad essere efficace nel perseguimento dei suoi obiettivi. Per questo cerchiamo sempre di mettere al centro **le nostre persone, preservarne il benessere e la motivazione, e valorizzarne le competenze**.


**Abbiamo grandi benefit**
--------------------------

* Work\-life balance
* Piano Welfare \& Wellbeing
* Onboarding strutturato
* Apprendimento continuo
* Innovazione
* Divertimento e socialità
**Riguardo all'azienda**
------------------------

**Save the Children è la più importante organizzazione internazionale indipendente che da oltre 100 anni lotta per salvare le bambine e i bambini a rischio** e garantire loro un futuro.


**Ogni giorno** **mettiamo in campo le nostre diverse professionalità,** in Italia e nel resto del mondo, per dare alle bambine e ai bambini l'opportunità di nascere e crescere sani, ricevere un'educazione ed essere protetti.



Entrando a far parte di Save the Children il tuo talento, le tue competenze e la tua esperienza sosterranno la nostra missione.


TrasparenzaSiamo personalmente responsabili nell’utilizzare le nostre risorse in modo efficiente e adottiamo il massimo livello di trasparenza nei confronti dei donatori, dei partner e, più di ogni altro, dei bambini.


AmbizioneSiamo esigenti con noi stessi e con i nostri colleghi, stabiliamo obiettivi ambiziosi e ci impegniamo per migliorare la qualità di tutto ciò che facciamo per i bambini.


CollaborazionePerseguiamo il rispetto reciproco, valorizziamo le diversità, e lavoriamo con i partner, unendo le forze a livello globale, per migliorare la vita dei bambini.


CreativitàSiamo aperti a nuove idee, ci adoperiamo per il cambiamento, e siamo pronti ad assumerci rischi per sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili per e con i bambini.


IntegritàLavoriamo aspirando sempre al massimo livello di onestà morale e comportamentale; non compromettiamo mai la nostra reputazione e agiamo sempre nel superiore interesse dei bambini.

Ti piace lavorare in un contesto industriale in cui precisione, organizzazione e capacità di collegare persone, documenti e attività fanno davvero la differenza?

Ondulit Italiana, azienda italiana attiva dal 1953 nello sviluppo di sistemi di copertura e soluzioni per l’involucro edilizio, cerca una nuova persona da inserire nella Segreteria dello stabilimento di Cisterna di Latina.

**Il ruolo**

Riportando al Direttore di Supply Chain e collaborando con i Responsabili di funzione e con le funzioni aziendali centrali, fornirai supporto amministrativo e organizzativo alle attività quotidiane dello stabilimento.

Il tuo obiettivo sarà garantire che informazioni, documenti e scadenze siano gestiti con precisione e tempestività, contribuendo alla continuità operativa e a una comunicazione efficace tra Produzione, Magazzino, Manutenzione, Laboratorio, Amministrazione e Risorse Umane.

**Di cosa ti occuperai**

· Fornire supporto amministrativo e organizzativo al Direttore di Supply Chain e ai Responsabili di funzione.

· Gestire il centralino, la posta elettronica, la corrispondenza e l’accoglienza di visitatori, fornitori e trasportatori.

· Predisporre, controllare e registrare documenti di trasporto e altra documentazione relativa ai flussi in ingresso e in uscita, interfacciandoti con Magazzino, Spedizioni e Amministrazione.

description:

Adopt Parfums continua la sua espansione in Italia, ed è per questo che siamo alla ricerca di Responsabile di Negozio per il nostro futuro punto vendita di **Roma, Centro Commerciale Roma Est.**

  

Un professionista delle vendite con la passione per il mondo della bellezza, unisciti a noi per condividere l'avventura di un ‘insegna in crescita’!


Missione:


* Alle dipendenze di un Direttore Regionale, sei responsabile di tutti gli aspetti del punto vendita e sei un ambasciatore del nostro marchio e dei nostri valori. La tua priorità in ogni momento: la soddisfazione dei nostri clienti.
* Siete fortemente orientati all'accoglienza, alla consulenza e alla fidelizzazione dei clienti e garantite una qualità ottimale del servizio nel negozio.
* Sviluppate le prestazioni commerciali del negozio grazie alla buona gestione degli incassi e al monitoraggio dei diversi indicatori: CA, scontrino medio, tasso di conversione, produttività oraria, obiettivi collettivi, ecc.
* Incoraggiate il vostro team nel rispetto dei valori aziendali e in una logica di sviluppo dei talenti.
* Incrementate le vendite garantendo un servizio clienti e un'immagine del negozio impeccabili.
* Assicurate la gestione amministrativa, delle risorse umane e della logistica del negozio. Garantite gli standard di qualità in termini di immagine (presentazione dei prodotti, merchandising e pulizia del negozio).
* Siete responsabili del buon funzionamento del punto vendita nel rispetto delle procedure e dell'adozione e diffusione dei valori aziendali.

  

L'ideale è avere un profilo commerciale combinato con una formazione estetica. Avete una comprovata esperienza nelle vendite e nella gestione dei team. Il vostro background vi permette di padroneggiare il monitoraggio degli indicatori commerciali, l'eccellenza del servizio clienti e la gestione della prossimità. Siete totalmente orientati al cliente, dinamici, reattivi e proattivi. Vi preoccupate di essere un esempio, comunicate in modo rispettoso ed efficace con i vostri team. Il vostro interesse per l'ambiente cosmetico è un elemento indispensabile per riuscire in questa missione.
